entries.a5e5d0c24e31edbe: A company centered on providing international telecommunications lines to the Philippines, which also handles domestic voice communications and medical care and health checkups in the Philippines.
entries.d3c617c9a481a0a2: Corporations and individuals using medical checkups and health screenings
entries.fcda480bb224a154: In the Philippines, the business provides ophthalmic medical care, including correction of nearsightedness through LASIK surgery, and dermatology medical care, and also operates medical checkup and health screening centers to provide preventive medicine. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,650 million.
